name: OpenAlex API
needs_key: optional (free key lifts keyless budget 10x; key required for cursor paging)
license: CC0 (per OpenAlex; not re-verified)
clause: "Basic queries work without a key" (paraphrase of page)
rate_limit: keyless 10 req/s per IP; free key 30 req/s; per_page max 100
eras: scholarship about any era; metadata only, 1000 BCE-present
notes: Best for finding and DOI-resolving secondary literature, not primary text. Abstracts are inverted-index. Do not request a key; use keyless.

name: Crossref REST API
license: Metadata free to reuse (not re-verified)
clause: "Anyone can access the REST API, no signup or registration is required."
eras: metadata for scholarship of any era
notes: Verify that a cited book/article exists, DOIs, years. No full text. Always send mailto.

name: Semantic Scholar API
needs_key: optional (shared pool keyless; key for dedicated rate)
license: Data under CC BY-NC / ODC-BY per dataset
clause: "attempt to exceed or circumvent limitations on access" is prohibited
rate_limit: not numeric on page; keyless shared pool is throttled
eras: scholarship metadata, mostly 1950+ but cites older work
notes: Non-commercial project fits CC BY-NC. License page has no AI/storage ban. Abstracts and TLDRs useful for claim checks.

name: CORE API
license: Per-record repository licenses; CORE metadata CC0-style (unverified)
robots: Disallow: /search only; content-signals reservation under EU DSM Art. 4 (no signal set yes/no)
clause: terms page returned 403 (bot wall); not read
eras: OA full texts of academic papers; history/archaeology theses and articles
notes: Needs key so cannot be used without signup. Robots reserves TDM rights without granting signals: treat as ask-first.

name: PubMed Central Open Access subset
license: Per-article CC licenses; some NC only
clause: "bulk retrieval of articles through any other automated process is prohibited"
notes: Only for medical-history claim checks. Use OA subset licensed CC0/BY/BY-SA for stored text.

name: arXiv API
license: Metadata CC0; papers per-author license
robots: arxiv.org robots: default allows abs/pdf/html, Crawl-delay 15, Disallow /api and /e-print on arxiv.org (API host is export.arxiv.org)
notes: Low value for this project except history-of-science and archaeoastronomy. Terms not verified.

name: DOAJ API
license: Metadata CC BY-SA (unverified)
robots: Allows site; disallows /search and account/admin; Content-signal permits search, AI input, reference; notes load limits
eras: OA journal index; finds history journals only
notes: Use to locate OA history articles, then fetch via publisher. Robots comment says openness may change if load is a problem.

name: Internet Archive (archive.org APIs)
license: Mixed: public-domain scans plus rights-held items; per item
clause: terms page returned no content; not read
eras: scans of printed books 1500-1923: 500-1800 CE strongest; also earlier editions of classics
regions: all, esp. Europe, Americas, South Asia (mirrors of DLI)
notes: Full OCR text via /download/{id}/{id}_djvu.txt. Check item rights before storing. Best single source of public-domain period texts.

name: scholar.archive.org / fatcat
license: Metadata CC0; fulltext per paper
robots: archive.org robots; scholar subdomain not separately fetched
notes: Same operator as IA; fatcat has open REST. Metadata mostly. Unverified details.

name: HathiTrust (Bib API, Data API)
needs_key: Data API: yes; Bib API: no
license: Public-domain volumes in US; rest search-only
notes: Bot wall on first request; not retried. Bib API (catalog only) likely fine but unverified. Full-text search and page views are human-only by HathiTrust policy (unverified).

name: Wikisource
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 for wiki text; source texts usually public domain
robots: /wiki/ allowed except Special: and admin pages; /w/ (incl. api.php) disallowed; SemrushBot delay 5
clause: terms not fetched; Wikimedia User-Agent policy applies
eras: transcribed primary texts: classical to 1900; strongest 1500-1900 English
notes: Allowed via /wiki/ article fetches or ?action=raw via index.php (note robots). Using api.php is bot-intended by Wikimedia but robots disallows /w/: pick /wiki/ paths. Quality varies (proofread level).

name: Perseus Digital Library (hopper) / Scaife
license: Texts CC BY-SA 4.0 (in canonical-greekLit/Latin repos; not re-verified)
robots: User-agent *: Disallow all except 5 /hopper/ paths (grants, research, about, collections, index); AI bots mostly blocked
clause: "The code for the digital library system and many of the collections" (about page; no automated-access terms)
eras: Greek and Latin classics, 800 BCE-500 CE; some Renaissance/19th C.
notes: Hopper text pages are outside robots-permitted paths. Use the GitHub corpora (PerseusDL/canonical-greekLit, canonical-latinLit; OpenGreekAndLatin/First1KGreek) via git instead: see next entry. Scaife robots not fetched.

name: Perseus / First1KGreek TEI corpora on GitHub
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (repo licenses; verify per repo)
notes: Preferred route for classical primary text: TEI-XML, stable URN citations. Verify repo LICENSE before storing. Not fetched this run.

name: Avalon Project (Yale Law)
license: Mostly public-domain documents; site (c) Lillian Goldman Law Library
clause: footer: "(c) 2008 Lillian Goldman Law Library"; no ToU page found
eras: legal/diplomatic documents: 4th c. BCE-21st c.; strongest 1500-2000
notes: Low confidence: no robots and no ToU found, so default allowed with polite pacing. Good for treaties, charters, declarations.

name: Fordham Internet History Sourcebooks
license: "copy-permitted, although not necessarily copyright-free"
eras: Ancient, Medieval, Modern, plus Africa, East Asia, India, Islam, Jewish, Women, LGBT sourcebooks
notes: Robots unreadable (500), so cannot confirm: browser read OK. Many texts are modernised translations of uncertain rights; do not store.

name: Founders Online (NARA/NHPRC)
license: Public-domain letters; editorial notes (c) University presses
notes: Narrow era window. A JSON API exists (?q=&format=json) but not verified. Check GitHub data dumps instead.

name: Library of Congress JSON API
license: Per item rights statement; many PD; metadata free
robots: User-agent *: Disallow /search /cgi-bin etc; Crawl-Delay: 5; Baiduspider blocked
clause: "The API is accessible to the public with no API key or authentication required."
rate_limit: Crawl-Delay 5 s; blocked when rate exceeded; paging cap 100,000
eras: 1500-present: maps, manuscripts, newspapers, photos; Americas strongest
notes: /search is robots-disallowed: use /collections/{slug}/ and /item/{id}/ ?fo=json instead. Follow 5 s delay.

name: Chronicling America (via loc.gov)
license: Public domain newspaper pages (pre-1964)
notes: Legacy chroniclingamerica API redirects to loc.gov. OCR is noisy: corroborate before citing.

name: Smithsonian Open Access API
license: CC0 for open-access records
notes: Needs signup key: not usable without one. Metadata mostly. Bulk data on GitHub (smithsonian/OpenAccess) is a keyless alternative (unverified).

name: Europeana API
license: Metadata CC0; item rights per record (RightsStatements)
robots: api host robots redirected to /en landing; not determinable
eras: European cultural heritage: manuscripts, maps, newspapers 500-1900
notes: Key needed. Full text in Europeana Newspapers via API (unverified).

name: DPLA API
license: Metadata CC0
notes: Key needed. Metadata with links; limited full text.

name: Gallica (BnF)
license: Reuse conditions per BnF (free for non-commercial; unverified)
notes: Bot wall on first request; not retried. APIs exist but cannot be confirmed.

name: Trove (NLA)
license: Newspaper text: public domain pre-1955; metadata per contributor
robots: robots.txt 403; pages return Anubis bot wall
notes: Bot wall. Key required anyway. Alternative: Papers Past for NZ.

name: Papers Past (NZ)
license: Text CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 NZ (known; not re-verified)
rate_limit: not stated; DigitalNZ API (key) is the sanctioned bulk route
notes: Robots allow article pages. Terms unread: low confidence, use polite pacing. DigitalNZ API requires key.

name: Delpher (KB Netherlands)
license: Public domain items; KB terms
notes: Bot wall; not retried.

name: Pleiades gazetteer
license: CC BY 3.0 (known; not re-verified)
robots: Crawl-delay 3; Disallow /collections/ /features/ /names/ etc.; named AI bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai) blocked entirely
notes: Prefer bulk dump download. Per-place JSON pages are not disallowed, but if the job UA identifies as an AI bot it is blocked. Place names and coordinates only.

name: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
license: (c) Metaphysics Research Lab / authors; non-commercial reading
clause: "read, download, copy, print, search, and link to entries, for non-commercial purposes"
eras: intellectual history, all eras; ancient/medieval strong
notes: Info page also: "Crawling entries for indexing is permitted". Quote only briefly, cite. Private storage for non-commercial fact-check fits.

name: World History Encyclopedia
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 on most articles (known; not re-verified)
robots: Allows /article/ etc; Disallows /search/ /related/; no AI-specific rules
eras: ancient to modern, strong pre-1000 CE
notes: Robots permit it but the terms page bot-walled the fetch, so no explicit automated-access consent found. Revisit if terms can be read by a human.

name: British History Online
license: Content provider, not owner: rights vary per volume
clause: "content provider rather than a content owner" (paraphrased from About page)
eras: British/Irish records 1000-1900: VCH, state papers, parish and city records
notes: Use free volumes only. No ToU page located: low confidence.

name: Metropolitan Museum Open Access API
license: CC0 for open-access objects
clause: "do not require API users to register or obtain an API key"
regions: global: Egypt, Near East, Asia, Americas, Africa, Europe
notes: Object dates, cultures, provenance; metadata only. Strong for pre-1000 BCE artifacts. Check isPublicDomain for images.

name: Rijksmuseum data services
needs_key: no (new Search API/OAI-PMH; legacy API needed key)
license: Rights per object, mostly CC0/PD (not re-verified)
robots: Site robots: allow except search results with queries, newsletters, login
clause: docs page lists access routes but not terms
eras: Dutch art and history 1500-1900; Asian and colonial objects
notes: Prefer data dumps/OAI-PMH over search. Terms not read.

name: Cambridge Digital Library
license: CC BY-NC on many images; varies
eras: manuscripts: Genizah, Newton, Sanskrit, Islamic, Chinese; 500-1800 strong
regions: Middle East, South Asia, East Asia, Europe
notes: Bot wall; not retried.

name: Sefaria
license: Per text: public domain, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC (check each)
robots: Disallow /activity/ and login/register next URLs only
clause: terms page returned only nav; not read
eras: Hebrew Bible, Talmud, Midrash, law, 1000 BCE-1800 CE
notes: Per-text license in API metadata (versionTitle/license). Full text also at github.com/Sefaria/Sefaria-Export (CC licenses per text). Official API is the intended route.

name: National Diet Library Search (Japan)
license: Metadata per provider; many CC BY / PDM
clause: "Individuals and non-profits need no application if they make no profit from the metadata." (paraphrase)
rate_limit: concurrent access capped; sustained load from one IP may be blocked
notes: Robots disallows /api for crawlers yet NDL publishes it for programmatic use: treat as sanctioned API, not crawl. Key not needed for non-profits. Metadata only; NDL Digital Collections have images.

name: CBETA / DILA Buddhist canon API
license: CBETA copyright notice (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 Taiwan, known; not re-verified)
robots: cbetaonline robots not determinable (SPA); cbdata not fetched
clause: API page lists no automated-access rules; links to cbeta.org/copyright.php
regions: East Asia, South Asia, Central Asia
notes: Downloadable TEI on GitHub is the safer route. Check copyright page before storing text.

name: Encyclopaedia Iranica
license: (c) Encyclopaedia Iranica Foundation
regions: Middle East, Central Asia, South Asia
notes: Bot wall; not retried. Cite only.

name: Digital Library of India
license: Mixed; many out-of-copyright scans
robots: not fetched; original site largely offline
notes: Not tested. Mirrors on Internet Archive follow IA API entry. Cite only.

name: Project Gutenberg
license: Public domain in US; trademark license for PG name
clause: not fetched; PG publicly asks bulk users to use mirrors/rsync, not crawling (unverified)
notes: Use mirror/Gutendex-style catalog (unverified), not crawling. Status 503 this run: retry later.

name: Open Library
license: Metadata CC0
robots: Disallows /api, /search, borrow; delay 10 s for AI-named bots (anthropic-ai, ClaudeBot)
rate_limit: 10 s crawl-delay applies to AI crawlers; bulk dumps preferred
notes: Robots disallow /api for crawlers; use monthly dumps (openlibrary.org/developers/dumps) instead. Metadata only.

name: Art Institute of Chicago API
license: CC0 for data
notes: Docs bot-walled in this fetch; known public API but unverified: not usable until read by a human.

name: Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access API
license: CC0
clause: "has waived all copyright and related or neighboring rights"
notes: No key, no stated rate limit; polite pacing.

name: Getty Vocabularies (AAT, TGN, ULAN)
license: ODC-By 1.0 (known; not re-verified)
notes: Authority data only, no narrative. Unverified.

name: Papyri.info / Trismegistos-style papyrology
license: CC BY 3.0 (known; not re-verified)
notes: Documentary papyri with dates. Prefer GitHub data repo. Narrow but strong for Egypt in the empty 1000 BCE-500 CE window.

name: ORACC (Cuneiform corpora)
license: Mostly CC BY-SA 3.0 (known; not re-verified)
notes: Host unreachable during run; not verified. Key for before-1000 BCE if accessible.

name: Wikidata
license: CC0
robots: Special pages blocked except Special:EntityData with file extensions; /w/ and /api/ disallowed
eras: structured data on people, dates, places, all eras
notes: Non-Wikipedia, CC0. Use EntityData JSON: robots-permitted. Dates need cross-checking.

name: Sacred-Texts
license: Mostly public-domain older translations; some (c)
robots: Allows everything except /signup /login; two bots blocked
notes: Old translations (Victorian); quality caveat. Terms not read.

name: CCEL (Christian Classics Ethereal Library)
license: Public domain / permissive per work
notes: Terms not read; pace at 10 s.

name: Zenodo
license: Per record
eras: datasets and papers; occasional historical corpora
notes: Robots blocks most /api paths: unclear if a job may use REST. Treat as ask-first.
